name: yieldlinks
description: Gift links that earn yield in SaucerSwap's Infinity Pool until claimed. Recipients need no wallet, HBAR or Hedera account.

steps.text: Set RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY in packages/nextjs/.env.local to a dedicated, lightly funded Hedera testnet account. It pays claim fees so recipients need no HBAR.

steps.label: 3. Get test SAUCE for the sending wallet
steps.text: Swap testnet HBAR for SAUCE at https://testnet.saucerswap.finance/ (or use the cast commands in the README, Quickstart step 4).

steps.label: 4. See it work on testnet in one command
